fields.description: The La Mer Villa Collection is a seven-bedroom beachfront mansion in Jumeirah 1. Its accommodation extends across basement, ground, first and roof levels, separating family living, guest rooms, staff accommodation and private entertainment spaces.

overview: The brief places the villa on a 21,934 ft² plot. Its seven ensuite bedrooms are separate from one chef’s room and four staff rooms.
Plans span basement, ground, first and roof levels. The brief describes six basement garage spaces and two covered entrance spaces.
research.locationNote: La Mer, Jumeirah 1, Dubai. This is the La Mer mansion, not the separate Palm Jumeirah or Emirates Hills collection.
research.priceLabel: Broker advertised reference · not a current offer

research.paymentNote: No developer-issued staged commercial schedule was retrieved. Emirates Estate shows 50/50 but also describes individual terms; this does not establish an applicable contract.
research.handoverNote: The branded brief anticipated Q4 2024. fäm claims handover on 1 October 2024, while the developer retains construction entries through December 2025. No completion certificate or actual selected-property handover was verified.
